name: Script Interpreter Investigation
description: Simulation-only response plan for suspicious script interpreter activity in a lab event.

actions.name: Collect process evidence
actions.description: Simulate collecting process name, command line, parent process, user, timestamp, and host context.

actions.name: Create investigation ticket
actions.description: Simulate opening an analyst review ticket with alert metadata and evidence links.

actions.name: Tag host for review
actions.description: Simulate tagging the lab host for follow-up. No isolation or containment is performed in the MVP.

safety_notes: This playbook does not isolate hosts.
This playbook does not kill processes.
This playbook does not collect credentials.
This playbook is safe for mock alerts only.

name: Valid Account Activity Review
description: Simulation-only response plan for identity-related suspicious activity in a lab event.

actions.name: Collect login context
actions.description: Simulate collecting login time, source, user, host, and MFA/context notes.

actions.name: Request human review
actions.description: Simulate routing the alert to a human analyst for approval before any account action.

safety_notes: Human approval is required for any real identity action.
